name: Ukishima ni Meguru Omoi
source:
Young people live happily on a small island. But one classmate decides to enter an urban university after graduation, and everyone is sad about it. Then one day teacher comes and declares that island will sink in seven days. How will this week pass?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
年轻人们在一座小岛上幸福生活。但一名同学决定毕业后前往都市的大学就读，大家都为此难过。某天，老师突然宣布岛屿将在七天后沉没。这一周会如何度过？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-february-2007-utsurigi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
